Market Insights
Markets and Bids
Real-Time Market Insights
At Aurora Cooperative, we provide real-time market information and competitive bids to ensure our farmer-owners get the best value for their grain.
View Markets
Grain
With over 100 million bushels of grain handled each year, we are ready to meet our owners’ needs. And thanks to key infrastructure investments, we’re ready to handle a future of increased yields and new markets for your grain.
Our marketing expertise, grain delivery systems and growing relationships help provide our owners with the best grain options available for your farm. From farm marketing plans to market advice, we make sure every farm does its best.

Products and Services
On-Farm Pick Up
Aurora Cooperative offers on-farm grain pick up services during harvest. Please call your Grain Merchandiser for more information.
Grain Marketing Contracts
Aurora Cooperative provides a variety of Grain Marketing Contracts to offer flexibility in managing your grain. For more details about our different contract options, please call your local Grain Merchandiser.
